messages.author: 5893d17d64b5b0c2
messages.subject: Re: builderrors, missing "data.frame" package
parts:
Hi Sami,

Packrat attempts to determine which packages your code is using by scanning the source code of your app. My guess is that it is incorrectly picking up the string "data.frame" in your code and thinking it's a package name.

Can you paste the lines in your app's source code that contain "data.frame" (without quotes)? If our conjecture is correct then we should be able to identify the line pretty quickly!

Jonathan.

messages.author: ddd2df4c54fbb241
messages.subject: Re: builderrors, missing "data.frame" package
parts:
Hi Jonathan, thanks for looking at this. Here is the code in server.r (not very polished). Dont think i use the data.frame function in the code.


library(shiny)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(jsonlite)
library(DT)
library(ggthemes)

stats <- fromJSON("https://api.trello.com/1/boards/<insert board id>/actions?limit=1000&key=<insert key here>&token=<insert token here>", flatten = T)

cards <- fromJSON("https://api.trello.com/1/boards/<insert board id>/cards?limit=1000&key=<insert key here>&token=<insert token here>", flatten = T)

cards <- cards %>%
  select(data_card_id = id, labels) %>%
  unnest(labels) %>%
  select(data_card_id, labels = name)

names(stats) <- stats %>% names %>% gsub("\\.", "_", .)
stats <- left_join(cards, stats)
stats$date <- stats$date %>% ymd_hms

stats_ <- stats[!is.na(stats$type),]

finish_dates <- stats_ %>% filter(data_listAfter_name == "Klar" | data_list_name == "Klar") %>% mutate(finished = date) %>% select(data_card_id, finished)
start_dates <- stats_ %>%
  filter(data_list_name != "Ideer") %>%
  # filter(type == "updateCard" | type == "createCard") %>%
  group_by(data_card_id) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  summarise(start_date = first(date))

stats_ <- left_join(stats_, finish_dates)
stats_ <- left_join(stats_, start_dates)

stats_ <- stats_ %>% mutate(duration = (start_date %--% finished) / ddays(1))

for_plot <- stats_ %>%
  filter(!is.na(duration)) %>%
  arrange(finished) %>%
  group_by(data_card_id, labels) %>%
  summarize(start = last(start_date), end = last(finished), duration =last(duration), card_name = last(data_card_name))

for_plot_uf <- stats_ %>%
  filter(is.na(duration), data_list_name != "Ideer") %>%
  mutate(finished = now(), duration = (start_date %--% finished) / ddays(1)) %>%
  arrange(finished) %>%
  group_by(data_card_id, labels) %>%
  summarize(start = last(start_date), end = last(finished), duration =last(duration), card_name = last(data_card_name))



# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  plot_data <- reactive({
    for_plot %>% filter(!(start < input$date_range[1] &
                            end < input$date_range[1])) %>%
      gather(key, dates, -data_card_id, -labels, -duration, -card_name) %>%
      filter(labels %in% input$swim_lane)
   
  })
 
  plot_data_uf <- reactive({
    for_plot_uf <- for_plot_uf %>% filter(!(start < input$date_range[1] &
                                              end < input$date_range[1])) %>%
      gather(key, dates, -data_card_id, -labels, -duration, -card_name) %>%
      filter(labels %in% input$swim_lane)
   
    for_plot_uf$dates <- as.POSIXct(for_plot_uf$dates, origin = "1970-01-01")
    for_plot_uf
   
   
  })
 
 

  output$table <- renderDataTable(plot_data() %>%
                                    group_by(labels) %>%
                                    summarise(mean = mean(duration) %>% round(0)) %>%
                                    arrange(mean) %>%
                                    rename(`swim lanes` = labels, `mean lead time (days)` = mean),
                                  options = list(dom = 't')
                                 
  )
 
  output$table_n <- renderDataTable(plot_data() %>%
                                      group_by(labels) %>%
                                      summarise(finished = n() / 2) %>%
                                      arrange(desc(finished)) %>%
                                      rename(`swim lanes` = labels, `# of finished epics` = finished),
                                    options = list(dom = 't'))
 
 
 
  output$actions <- renderDataTable(stats_ %>% filter(!(date < input$date_range[1]),
                                                      (type == "updateCard" & !is.na(data_listAfter_name)) |
                                                        (type == "createCard" & is.na(data_listAfter_name)) |
                                                        (type == "emailCard"& is.na(data_listAfter_name))) %>%
                                      mutate(data_list_name = ifelse(is.na(data_list_name),
                                                                     data_listAfter_name,
                                                                     data_list_name)) %>%
                                      select(date,
                                             epic = data_card_name,
                                             swim_lane = labels,
                                             column_now =
                                               data_list_name,
                                             column_previously =
                                               data_listBefore_name) %>%
                                      arrange(desc(date)) %>% unique,
                                    options = list(lengthMenu = c(50,100,250,500), pageLength = 100),
                                    rownames= FALSE)
 
 
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(plot_data(), aes(factor(card_name,
                                   levels = card_name[order(duration, decreasing = T)]),
                            duration,
                            fill = labels)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position="dodge") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
      theme_pander() +
      scale_fill_pander() +
      labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = "Lead time in days", fill = "Swim lanes\n")
   
  })
  output$plot_gantt <- renderPlot({
    df <- plot_data()
    df$dates <- df$dates %>% as.Date
    ggplot(df, aes(dates,
                   factor(card_name,
                          levels = card_name[order(dates)]),
                   colour = labels)) +
      geom_line(size = 6) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(input$date_range[1], input$date_range[2])) +
      theme_pander() +
      scale_fill_pander() +
      labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Swim lanes\n")
   
  })
  output$plot_gantt_unfinished <- renderPlot({
    df <- plot_data_uf()
    df$dates <- df$dates %>% as.Date
    ggplot(df, aes(dates,
                   factor(card_name,
                          levels = card_name[order(dates)]),
                   colour = labels)) +
      geom_line(size = 6) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(input$date_range[1], input$date_range[2])) +
      theme_pander() +
      scale_fill_pander() +
      labs(title = NULL,
           x = NULL,
           y = NULL,
           color = "Swim lanes\n")   
  })
 
 
})

messages.subject: Re: builderrors, missing "data.frame" package
parts:
Packrat scans not just server.r but every file in the directory. It is possible that one of the other files in the directory is causing the problem. Would you be willing to run a search for data.frame in the same directory as server.r?

Also, what does

packrat:::dirDependencies(".")

return when run in the same directory as server.r?

Jonathan.

On Thursday, April 13, 2017 at 2:50:49 PM UTC-7, Sami Kallinen wrote:
Hi Jonathan, thanks for looking at this. Here is the code in server.r (not very polished). Dont think i use the data.frame function in the code.


library(shiny)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(jsonlite)
library(DT)
library(ggthemes)

stats <- fromJSON("https://api.trello.com/1/boards/<insert board id>/actions?limit=1000&key=<insert key here>&token=<insert token here>", flatten = T)

cards <- fromJSON("https://api.trello.com/1/boards/<insert board id>/cards?limit=1000&key=<insert key here>&token=<insert token here>", flatten = T)

cards <- cards %>%
  select(data_card_id = id, labels) %>%
  unnest(labels) %>%
  select(data_card_id, labels = name)

names(stats) <- stats %>% names %>% gsub("\\.", "_", .)
stats <- left_join(cards, stats)
stats$date <- stats$date %>% ymd_hms

stats_ <- stats[!is.na(stats$type),]

finish_dates <- stats_ %>% filter(data_listAfter_name == "Klar" | data_list_name == "Klar") %>% mutate(finished = date) %>% select(data_card_id, finished)
start_dates <- stats_ %>%
  filter(data_list_name != "Ideer") %>%
  # filter(type == "updateCard" | type == "createCard") %>%
  group_by(data_card_id) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  summarise(start_date = first(date))

stats_ <- left_join(stats_, finish_dates)
stats_ <- left_join(stats_, start_dates)

stats_ <- stats_ %>% mutate(duration = (start_date %--% finished) / ddays(1))

for_plot <- stats_ %>%
  filter(!is.na(duration)) %>%
  arrange(finished) %>%
  group_by(data_card_id, labels) %>%
  summarize(start = last(start_date), end = last(finished), duration =last(duration), card_name = last(data_card_name))

for_plot_uf <- stats_ %>%
  filter(is.na(duration), data_list_name != "Ideer") %>%
  mutate(finished = now(), duration = (start_date %--% finished) / ddays(1)) %>%
  arrange(finished) %>%
  group_by(data_card_id, labels) %>%
  summarize(start = last(start_date), end = last(finished), duration =last(duration), card_name = last(data_card_name))



# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
  plot_data <- reactive({
    for_plot %>% filter(!(start < input$date_range[1] &
                            end < input$date_range[1])) %>%
      gather(key, dates, -data_card_id, -labels, -duration, -card_name) %>%
      filter(labels %in% input$swim_lane)
   
  })
 
  plot_data_uf <- reactive({
    for_plot_uf <- for_plot_uf %>% filter(!(start < input$date_range[1] &
                                              end < input$date_range[1])) %>%
      gather(key, dates, -data_card_id, -labels, -duration, -card_name) %>%
      filter(labels %in% input$swim_lane)
   
    for_plot_uf$dates <- as.POSIXct(for_plot_uf$dates, origin = "1970-01-01")
    for_plot_uf
   
   
  })
 
 

  output$table <- renderDataTable(plot_data() %>%
                                    group_by(labels) %>%
                                    summarise(mean = mean(duration) %>% round(0)) %>%
                                    arrange(mean) %>%
                                    rename(`swim lanes` = labels, `mean lead time (days)` = mean),
                                  options = list(dom = 't')
                                 
  )
 
  output$table_n <- renderDataTable(plot_data() %>%
                                      group_by(labels) %>%
                                      summarise(finished = n() / 2) %>%
                                      arrange(desc(finished)) %>%
                                      rename(`swim lanes` = labels, `# of finished epics` = finished),
                                    options = list(dom = 't'))
 
 
 
  output$actions <- renderDataTable(stats_ %>% filter(!(date < input$date_range[1]),
                                                      (type == "updateCard" & !is.na(data_listAfter_name)) |
                                                        (type == "createCard" & is.na(data_listAfter_name)) |
                                                        (type == "emailCard"& is.na(data_listAfter_name))) %>%
                                      mutate(data_list_name = ifelse(is.na(data_list_name),
                                                                     data_listAfter_name,
                                                                     data_list_name)) %>%
                                      select(date,
                                             epic = data_card_name,
                                             swim_lane = labels,
                                             column_now =
                                               data_list_name,
                                             column_previously =
                                               data_listBefore_name) %>%
                                      arrange(desc(date)) %>% unique,
                                    options = list(lengthMenu = c(50,100,250,500), pageLength = 100),
                                    rownames= FALSE)
 
 
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(plot_data(), aes(factor(card_name,
                                   levels = card_name[order(duration, decreasing = T)]),
                            duration,
                            fill = labels)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position="dodge") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
      theme_pander() +
      scale_fill_pander() +
      labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = "Lead time in days", fill = "Swim lanes\n")
   
  })
  output$plot_gantt <- renderPlot({
    df <- plot_data()
    df$dates <- df$dates %>% as.Date
    ggplot(df, aes(dates,
                   factor(card_name,
                          levels = card_name[order(dates)]),
                   colour = labels)) +
      geom_line(size = 6) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(input$date_range[1], input$date_range[2])) +
      theme_pander() +
      scale_fill_pander() +
      labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Swim lanes\n")
   
  })
  output$plot_gantt_unfinished <- renderPlot({
    df <- plot_data_uf()
    df$dates <- df$dates %>% as.Date
    ggplot(df, aes(dates,
                   factor(card_name,
                          levels = card_name[order(dates)]),
                   colour = labels)) +
      geom_line(size = 6) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(input$date_range[1], input$date_range[2])) +
      theme_pander() +
      scale_fill_pander() +
      labs(title = NULL,
           x = NULL,
           y = NULL,
           color = "Swim lanes\n")   
  })
 
 
})
